name: Chicken Breast
description: Skinless, boneless chicken breast is a lean, high-protein meat choice that is popular among fitness enthusiasts and healthy eaters alike.

faqs.q: How much protein is in 100g of chicken breast?
faqs.a: There are approximately 31 grams of high-quality protein in a 100-gram serving of skinless, boneless chicken breast.

faqs.q: Is chicken breast good for weight loss?
faqs.a: Yes, chicken breast is excellent for weight loss due to its low calorie content and high protein density, which promotes satiety.
